lines.speaker: cook
lines.text: Started a fire trying to make toast.

lines.speaker: witness
lines.text: The bread was already toasted?

lines.speaker: cook
lines.text: I was just holding it near the stove for moral support.

lines.speaker: builder
lines.text: Built a ladder to nowhere. It goes up. It does not come down.

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: builder
lines.text: I live there now. Send sandwiches.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Accidentally punched a cow while trying to pet it.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Is the cow okay?

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: The cow filed a formal complaint with the council.

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: Called in sick because I got stuck in a doorframe.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: How did three people get wedged at once?

lines.speaker: worker
lines.text: None of us was willing to yield right of way.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Fell down a well. Not the main well. Just a decorative one.

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: Are you hurt?

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: The shame is far worse than the bruises.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Wolf pack spotted heading toward the east pasture!

lines.speaker: guard
lines.text: Sound the alarm and draw bows!

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Everyone inside the palisade, now!

lines.speaker: lover_a
lines.text: Meet me past the lumber mill after curfew.

lines.speaker: lover_b
lines.text: The guards are patrolling the north gate.

lines.speaker: lover_a
lines.text: I left the side latch unbolted. Don't be late.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: The village goat has accused me of stealing its hat.

lines.speaker: lawyer
lines.text: The goat has produced three witnesses and a charcoal sketch.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: That sketch is just a circle with horns!

lines.speaker: lawyer
lines.text: The court will decide if artistic license constitutes evidence.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Who appointed you as the goat's legal counsel?

lines.speaker: lawyer
lines.text: The goat. It paid me in buttons and unblinking eye contact.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: The goat has learned how to open the grain shed latch.

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: Put a padlock on it.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: I tried. It watched me hide the key under the flowerpot.
